why_best: Evolving the text's internal presence while holding its spatial position gives the headline instant editorial power without disrupting the user's visual frame of reference.
why_bad: Translating or scaling the entire text block across the vertical screen causes layout jitter and forces the viewer to chase moving type across the viewport.
trap: Allowing the text baseline or surrounding bounds to shift even a single pixel during the transformation breaks the seamless, grounded illusion.
